data.semanticRole: A general-purpose Worker Agent whose pose reads as calm, capable, and available for selected park work.

pivot.rule: Pivot at the center of the wheel or foot contact patch; all robot variants retain the same ground contact.

animation.reducedMotionEquivalent: The static base pose conveys availability; DOM status text conveys all work and movement state.

accessibilityEquivalent.textDescription: A selected general-purpose Worker Agent available for park tasks.
accessibilityEquivalent.soundSubstitution: Persistent Agent status history names task and outcome; no meaning depends on sound.
accessibilityEquivalent.shapeCue: A compact upright body, single clear head unit, and stable ground contact distinguish the robot without color.

acceptanceChecklist: Matches the shared south-east three-quarter orientation and lighting.
Reads as one calm, competent Worker Agent at 64 by 80 pixels.
Contains no letters, numbers, logos, labels, or other embedded text.
Keeps the complete silhouette and contact shadow inside safe bounds.
Uses a transparent background with clean, fringe-free edges.
Keeps the declared pivot and ground contact stable across future variants.
Preserves tool attachment space without obscuring the head or status silhouette.
Relies on the declared DOM label and text status for essential meaning.
